message: 権力は鉄っぽい味がするかも？

name: Nanaka
message: 「You didn't have to tag along, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Am I getting in the way?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not like that. As the president, you're supposed to sit back and hold down the fort at HQ」

name: Synn
message: 「When everyone else is bustling around, it feels kind of restless for me to just be kicking back」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're such a workaholic」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait... do you think I'm unreliable?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you came with me instead of anyone else, didn't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「I was thinking about helping somebody out, and you just happened to be getting up from your seat」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's it?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Instant reply, huh」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This is where you're supposed to whisper something sweet, passionate, and longing, like, 'I didn't want to be with the other girls--I wanted to be with you, Nanaka'」

name: Synn
message: 「What's that supposed to be?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Do that and any girl will fall head over heels. That's just how women work」

name: Synn
message: 「'I didn't want to be with the other girls--I wanted to be with you, Nanaka'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not in a total monotone!」

name: Paqy
message: 「I didn't want to be with the other girls--I wanted to be by your side」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're not a panda」

name: Paqy
message: 「I'm not a panda!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. That's pretty deep」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, did you notice anything while making your rounds?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Everyone looked like they were having fun, so I'm really glad.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A huge success?」

name: Synn
message: 「At least so far, yeah. A ton of guests showed up, too.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, no matter how you slice it, I played a pretty big part in this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Having everyone from the shopping district participate is largely thanks to you, Nanaka.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Aw shucks, ahaha.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, no! You're the Student Council President, you know!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shouldn't you put your foot down and say something like, 'This is all thanks to me. Bow down and worship'?」

name: Synn
message: 「I couldn't have done anything on my own. It's all thanks to everyone.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Everyone, huh... What about Sally?」

name: Synn
message: 「Umm... In charge of helping everyone relax?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now that's one way to spin it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And you even phrased it as a question!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you hungry?」

name: Synn
message: 「No, not at all!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, come on, you totally are.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're hearing things! An auditory hallucination!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Want to grab a quick bite?」

name: Synn
message: 「No way!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way...? Oh. Right.」
That's right. Even though the smell of food is wafting from all around me, I have practically no way of getting my hands on any.
Sigh, and I'm the Student Council President, too.

name: Synn
message: 「This must be what they call loneliness in a crowd.」

name: Paqy
message: 「No way, it's what you call starvation amidst plenty」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah, quit saying ridiculous stuff with a serious face!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Lord Synn. Here, our only move is to eat first and skip out on paying」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Shoplifting!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, come on」

name: Paqy
message: 「Otherwise, just grab whatever's lined up over there and swallow it down right away」

name: Synn
message: 「Dine-and-dashing!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're practically the same thing. Besides, more than anything, Synn's face is way too famous」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It'd be fine if I weren't famous!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Not fine, no. Still better than watching my childhood friend starve to death」

name: Paqy
message: 「At this point, you've gotta own it and become the shoplifting, bag-snatching Student Council President」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh, that makes sense... Not!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the Student Council President, so you'll be fine」

name: Synn
message: 「Ehh!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't give me 'ehh.' You're the Student Council President, after all. The central figure behind KiraFes. They'll gladly treat you to a little something」

name: Synn
message: 「No, even so」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're serving sandwiches over there, so why don't you show your face?」
Now, the time has come for the Student Council President's authority to be put to the test!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gah, you're so slow!」

name: Synn
message: 「W-Whoa. Don't pull me! I-I'm not mentally prepared yet」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Student Council President? Who's that?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That would be me......」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Hmm. Is that so. Well, what do you want?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Umm...」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Don't tell me you're gonna ask me to hand over some food just 'cause you're starving?」

name: Synn
message: 「N-Never in a million years!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Heh. I can see right through your pathetic little scheme.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I stand humbled!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「Listen up--someone without money ain't a customer!」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek! Please forgive me!」

name: Tennouji-san
message: 「I won't forgive you! I'm gonna beat that rotten attitude straight out of you with this spirit-correcting stick! Get down right there, it's a hundred lashes!」

name: Synn
message: 「Help me!」
Easier done than feared.
When my stomach growled in front of the vendor, I was met with a gaze full of compassion--and food!

name: Synn
message: 「And what's more, it's free!」
In front of me sat black tea, a ham sandwich, and a cheese sandwich.
For the first time, I truly felt the (culinary) greatness of being Student Council President!

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even so, are you really tearing up from emotion?」

name: Synn
message: 「I mean, I mean, it's free!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You really are a struggling student, aren't you, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「The kindness of others really sinks into your soul...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, you're the Student Council President, so isn't it fine to get a little perk like this?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I see... So this is the taste of the Student Council President's authority.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Besides, you're popular in the shopping district, Synn. Treating you to a single meal is nothing for them.」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...And now you're full-on crying.」

name: Synn
message: 「This is the taste of the Student Council President's authority! Authority ham and authority cheese!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Sounds nasty.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「For once, I agree.」

name: Synn
message: 「True... I feel like it's starting to taste metallic」

name: Paqy
message: 「At times like that, you just gotta think of it as 'power ham' and 'power cheese'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「H-How simplistic!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, when I think of it like that, it feels like it's starting to taste good again!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Foreign loanwords sure are magical」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sigh... You're such a cheap date」

name: Synn
message: 「It really is delicious, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Master Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「What is it」

name: Paqy
message: 「Stop wolfing it down so fast and enjoy your meal a little more」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. It's bad for your digestion, too」

name: Synn
message: 「But... we're in the middle of patrol, so」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even if your company is just Soba, you're still eating with a girl, ya know. I think it's fine if you two flirt a little more」

name: Synn
message: 「Pfft! *Cough, cough*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wha--what are you saying!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, right, I guess Soba isn't a girl, huh」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I am a girl! That's not the point--why would I have to flirt with Synn!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba was the one who forcefully invited you to this meal, too. Any normal person would take that as a sign she's into you」

name: Synn
message: 「That's a huge stretch. Eating with Nanaka is an everyday occurrence」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Y-Yeah! It's just what we always do!」

name: Synn
message: 「There's no way Nanaka would invite me with that kind of intention」

name: Nanaka
message: 「R-Right, right. I've never even thought of Synn as a guy anyway」

name: Synn
message: 「I've never thought of Nanaka as a girl either」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Hold on a second」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Saying that to a cute maiden like me--isn't that going way too far?」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if you say that... you're my childhood friend, Nanaka, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That has nothing to do with my gender」

name: Synn
message: 「You've never looked at me that way either, Nanaka, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「O-Of course I haven't!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We're just childhood friends, after all」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... this is getting good」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well then, I'm going to keep doing my rounds, so take your time eating, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? I'll come too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No, it's fine, really. Patrolling around here is my job」
Nanaka left.
It almost looked like she was running away.

name: Paqy
message: 「She got mad and took off 'cause you didn't woo her properly, Master Synn」

name: Paqy
message: 「Shikim?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Why on earth would I have to woo Nanaka?!」
We're childhood friends. That's all we are.
